environmental_conditions.motivo: long-term averages; the paper publishes no weather covariates

campi_del_mandato.instrument: Soil: third quartiles of soil-gas radon and permeability per the uniform Czech method (Neznal et al. 2004). Indoor: track detectors, electrets and continuous monitors, declared per row
campi_del_mandato.licence: Not declared in the PDF; public document on the author's site
campi_del_mandato.missing_values: Every indoor value is CENSORED: a bound or an approximation, carried by the qualifier column, never a point. Horni Slavkov A has no tabulated soil parameters. The project bibliography claimed fifteen houses; the paper tabulates five, and the project report that would hold the rest is not public.
campi_del_mandato.sampling_frequency: One value per house and zone, with the averaging period declared per row
campi_del_mandato.site: Five real houses in the Czech Republic (Lounovice A and B, Potucky, Horni Slavkov A and B), four of them with soil-gas radon and permeability of the building site
campi_del_mandato.soil_properties: cA75 and k75 of the building site; no laboratory soil sample parameters
campi_del_mandato.split: Validation of the WIDTH of ring B, not of its central value: four houses at comparable radon potential span more than 2.6 decades of transfer factor, with censoring making that a lower bound. Never a calibration target: N=4 and every value is a bound.
campi_del_mandato.timestamp: Measured 2004-2005; source reopened and re-read in full on 2026-08-31 before transcription
campi_del_mandato.units: Soil-gas kBq/m3; permeability m2; indoor Bq/m3
